_meta.name: Can Name All Three Branches of Government
_meta.unit: percent of adults naming all three branches (online panel)
_meta.source: Annenberg Public Policy Center, Constitution Day Civics Survey
_meta.note: "Would you mind naming any of them, the three branches of government?" — percent of all respondents naming executive, legislative, and judicial, from APPC's annual Constitution Day survey (SSRS Opinion Panel, self-administered online, fielded each August–September). The survey moved from telephone to this online panel: APPC's own 2022 parallel run measured 72% online against 47% by phone (~25-point mode effect) and says the online years "will not be presented as part of a historical trend" with the phone years — so the phone era is a separate line (appcBranchesPhone) and the two are never joined. The 2022 value here is that parallel online reading.
_meta.method: transcribed from APPC topline PDFs (read 2026-08-31): 2023 topline CIVI4 table (2023 + 2022 online panel), 2025 topline 'Number of Branches Correctly Recalled' table (2024, 2025)
